headline: Cirrus Logic role links SV-RNM models to analog design, UVM verification, HW/SW validation, and AMS-UVM reuse
fact: As observed September 14, Cirrus Logic listed an Analog Mixed Signal Modeling & Verification Engineer role for Austin, Chandler and Greensboro. It assigns equivalent models reused across analog design, UVM verification and HW/SW validation; SV-RNM, SV-UDT and Verilog-AMS; DMS/AMS plans and platforms; regression debug; and verification-component reuse in AMS-UVM. The original UL-01 page is now unavailable. Related current UL-02 role, observed October 25, repeats those duties and adds architectural exploration and design-partitioning input. The postings establish a reusable-model methodology hiring mandate, not measured deployment. No reliable first-publication date is exposed, so the September observation date remains.
